name: Q-Interline A/S
summary: Q-Interline A/S specializes in the creation and production of advanced analytical systems and precise measurement devices. These instruments are vital for enhancing the quality of industrial processes and optimizing finished goods. The company's diverse portfolio includes solutions such as the quant analyser, InSight Pro, DairyQuant Go, AnalyticTrust, proficiency test, InSightView, and InfraQuant. Its expertise serves a wide array of sectors, including dairy, agriculture, food and ingredients, chemical, and pharmaceutical industries. Established in 1996, Q-Interline A/S is situated in Tølløse, Denmark.
